Historical full-card image of [[An Unusual Amount Of Fear (V) (Virtual Set 17: The Force Unleashed) (Original)|An Unusual Amount Of Fear]], matching the [[Virtual Set 17: The Force Unleashed]] publisher slip. It combines the underlying Decipher card and the Virtual slip. The same image was recovered unchanged from the Holotable large-image distribution through Virtual Set 17.
